sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234466 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Closure order 01-14-05-26-03 (from March 16, 2026) for reconstruction and improvements: 'the campground will be closed the entirety of the 2026 season and is currently not available to reserve on recreation.gov.'

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/alerts/timberlane-campground-closure ('A closure order is now in effect for the Timberlane Campground ... while it undergoes much-needed improvements', 'the campground will be closed the entirety of the 2026 season'; Alert Start Date March 16, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed and available to rent from May 15 through September 10.' Locked gate: the combination comes from the Libby Ranger District.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/timberlane-campground (Operational Hours) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234466 (notice 'For more information, including combination and instructions to open the locked gate, contact the Libby Ranger District at 406-293-7773'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Only the group shelter is priced: $75/night for 1-100 people, $150/night for 101-200 (shelter with one 15-amp outlet). No single-site fee is published.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/timberlane-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Group Shelter (electric): $75 per night (1-100 people), $150 per night (101-200)'; updated April 30, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov lists only one unit here, the group shelter site (GROUP SHELTER ELECTRIC, 7 consecutive days maximum, check-in/out noon). How the 'nearly a dozen' single-family sites are taken is not stated.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234466 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 7 'consecutive days'; notice 'Check in/out is at 12:00 noon') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234466 (1 site: GROUP SHELTER ELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water: the description lists 'drinking water' but the amenity section says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' A 20x20-ft group shelter with grills and one 15-amp outlet; horseshoe pits, volleyball court, grassy field, 1-mile loop trail. Gravel parking.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/timberlane-campground ('The campground includes vault toilets, drinking water, cooking grills, and a 15 amp electrical receptacle with limited capabilities located at the shelter', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'Parking surfaces are gravel.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Nearly a dozen single-family campsites, each equipped with a table and campfire ring with grill', plus the group shelter site (up to 200 people).

note: FS campground and group site along Pipe Creek NW of Libby, Kootenai NF (Libby RD, ~2,600 ft), in mixed conifer: from Libby cross the Kootenai River bridge, then 8 mi north on Pipe Creek Road 68 to the gate, about 1 mi past the community of Pipe Creek. Fishing and swimming in Pipe Creek. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Apr 30, 2026), closure alert and recreation.gov: confirmed the 2026-season closure (order from March 16, 2026; no reopening date, so reopens '2027' -> 'after the 2026 season (no date announced)'); added May 15-Sept 10 season, vault toilets, group-shelter pricing. Cleared the derived 14-night limit (rec.gov: 7 days, for the group shelter). Recreation.gov lists only the group shelter; how single sites are taken is unstated. Note trimmed of restated values and the closure (now in status).
flags: Temporary closure (whole 2026 season, closure order 01-14-05-26-03) recorded; reopening date not announced - recheck in spring 2027.
